business: ILLUSTRUS — site-uri și automatizări pentru consultanți în fonduri europene
by_segment: Established firm, 8-15 people, 50+ clients, several programmes
Small consulting firm, 3-8 people, 20-50 active clients
Solo consultant / PFA-style firm, 1-2 people, 5-15 clients a year
why_not: The document-upload and reminder automation would genuinely save my team hours, and 2,400 plus 140 a month is nothing against what we bill. But I would be putting my clients' dossiers and my intake flow on a 12-month contract with one man who does this after his day job; if he gets a better offer or burns out, I am the one explaining to 50 clients why the upload link is dead.

The 'launch price for the first two clients' tells me nobody in Romania is using this yet, and the person building it does it on the side, 10-12 hours a week, next to a day job. I already lost money once to an agency that vanished; I am not paying 1,200 EUR up front to a one-man evening project with no portfolio.

Every web guy in Oradea quotes me 400 to 900 EUR for a site, and this is 2,400 plus 140 a month for twelve months, so over 4,000 EUR in the first year for something that openly does not promise me a single new client. The document-chasing automation is the only part that speaks to my real problem, and I am not paying a site-builder's price to get it as a bundle.

My firm brings in about 43,000 EUR a year and this is 4,080 EUR in the first year before VAT, nearly a tenth of my revenue, for a site that replaces one that still works. With 5 to 15 clients a year I do not have a flood of unqualified requests to automate away; most of my work comes by phone and recommendation.

My clients come from referrals and from the agricultural directorate, not from Google; the only part I would actually pay for is the document upload link with automatic reminders, and I cannot buy that without a 2,400 EUR website and a 12-month contract on top. Right now I have two applications due Friday, so this goes in the pile.

Every one of my 5-15 clients a year came from someone else's recommendation, and I have never seen a farmer or an SME owner in Bihor pick a grant writer off Google. Four thousand euro in the first year is close to a tenth of my firm's revenue, spent on fixing a problem I don't have.
flip: A second named person behind the business, or the automations built on an account I own (my own Microsoft 365 / n8n / whatever) with a written handover so that if ILLUSTRUS disappears tomorrow everything keeps running without him.

A named consulting firm in Bihor or Bucharest that has run this for at least six months, whose owner I can call myself, plus a written continuity plan (who takes over hosting and the automations if he stops).

Sell me the document-collection and eligibility pre-check automations on their own, around 800 to 1,000 EUR setup and under 60 a month, month-to-month, and show me one grant consultant whose farmer clients actually use the upload link.

A reference call with a grant-consulting firm like mine that has run both automations for at least six months, plus an option to buy the two automations without the website or with a shorter commitment.

A named consultant in Bihor or Bucharest with a finished site and six months of the automations running, who I can call and who says the pre-check actually cut their calls and did not lose them anyone.

A one-time price with ordinary hosting of 15 to 20 EUR a month and no 12-month lock-in, or the START package at around 800 EUR plus hosting, so I can finally take the 2019 programmes off my site without a subscription.

Sell me the two automations without the website, show me a live demo on my own intake form, and give me one reference from a consultancy that has run the document-chasing flow with real farmers for at least three months.

Sell me the document-upload link with the automatic reminders on its own, around 500-700 EUR setup and 30-40 a month, without the website; that I'd try, because chasing attachments is where my hours really go.

A named second person or company who takes over support and the automations if he stops, written into the contract, plus a reference call with one of the first two clients after they have been live for six months.
Sell me the two automations on their own, plugged into the site I already have, for under 1,000 EUR setup, and show me one Romanian grant consultant who has been using them for six months.
A grant consultant in Bihor or Bucharest I can phone, who has run the document automation for at least a year with farmer and SME clients and tells me the chasing really dropped.

Sell me only the two automations, without the site, for a few hundred euros setup and under 60 a month, and let me call one consultant in Bihor who has used the document-upload link with actual farmers for at least three months.

Two named consulting firms in Romania who have been live on it for at least six months, that I can call myself, plus a written continuity clause: if support stops, I get the automations handed over in a form my own IT person can run.

Sell me the document collection and reminders automation on its own for a few hundred euro plus a small monthly fee, with the AI eligibility check switched off or at most flagging missing data, and let me talk to one Romanian grant consultant who has used it for a full application season.

Let me feed the eligibility check my last 20 real requests and show me it gets at least the obvious ones right, or give me the phone number of one Romanian grant consultant who has used the document portal through a full submission round. Either of those and I would take the launch price.

Two consultants I actually know, in my field, telling me over coffee that the document-chasing automation alone saved them real hours during a call deadline, and a written answer to what happens to my site and automations if he stops.

Sell me the document-collection and reminder automation on its own, for a few hundred euro and a small monthly fee, with no website and no 12-month lock-in; if it saves me two drives a month I'd pay for it gladly.

If a consultant I know in Bihor showed me the document-chasing automation actually working on their clients and the setup price were around 1,200 EUR with no 12-month lock-in, I would look at it seriously.

Two named consultants in Romania I can call who have been live on his sites for at least six months, plus a month-to-month subscription instead of a 12-month lock-in, and I would seriously look at the START package to replace my old site.

Sell me the document-collection and reminder automation alone, hooked to my existing clients, for a few hundred euro setup and something like 50 a month, with a colleague in Oradea or Bucharest I can call who already uses it.
